prompt: Complete a static paint method that lays a half-transparent blue band over a red rectangle using AlphaComposite, then restores full opacity for a final green tab.
explanation: AlphaComposite.getInstance(SRC_OVER, 0.5f) makes every later fill blend half of the new colour with half of whatever was already there, so the same blue band produces two different results depending on the pixels underneath. The composite is state on the Graphics2D, like the colour and the stroke, so it keeps applying until you replace it -- AlphaComposite.SrcOver is the fully opaque default. This is exactly how translucent overlays and fade effects are built in Swing.
hints: AlphaComposite.getInstance(AlphaComposite.SRC_OVER, alpha) takes a float, so write 0.5f.
Set the composite before the blue fill and reset it before the green one.
AlphaComposite.SrcOver is the constant that means fully opaque normal drawing.
